map.公差 = 上偏差 − 下偏差，极限尺寸 = 基本尺寸 ± 偏差。: Tolerance = upper deviation - lower deviation, and limit dimensions = basic size plus/minus deviation.
map.尺寸公差：公差 T = 上偏差 es − 下偏差 ei；最大极限尺寸 = 基本尺: Dimensional tolerance: tolerance T = upper deviation es - lower deviation ei; maximum limit size = basic size + es, minimum limit size = basic size + ei; tolerance-zone center = basic size + (es + ei) / 2. A smaller tolerance demands higher machining precision and higher cost, so pick it according to the required fit.
map.偏差可正可负。: Deviations can be positive or negative.
map.配合性质由公差带决定。: The type of fit is set by the tolerance zone.
map.公差 = USL - LSL。例：轴 20±0.05，USL=20.05、LSL: Tolerance = USL - LSL. Example: a shaft at 20±0.05 has USL=20.05, LSL=19.95 and a tolerance of 0.10 mm.
map.公差=0.021−(−0.007)=0.028 mm；最大极限尺寸 30.021: Tolerance = 0.021 - (-0.007) = 0.028 mm; maximum limit size 30.021 mm, minimum limit size 29.993 mm. A negative lower deviation must be substituted with its sign.
map.只给 USL 或 LSL，另一侧由功能要求定。: Only USL or LSL is given and the other side follows from the functional requirement.
map.孔轴公差带相对位置决定间隙/过盈配合。: The relative position of the hole and shaft tolerance zones determines a clearance or interference fit.
